translationRepairs: On Yichou of the first month of spring in the first year of Jianshi, the temple of the Imperial great-grandfather Dao Kao suffered a disaster.
On Yichou of the first month of spring in the first year of Jianshi, the temple of the imperial great-grandfather Daokao suffered a disaster.
悼考 is one posthumous designation; splitting it as Dao Kao invents two name elements for the single temple title 悼考廟.
Jianshi first year spring first month Yichou, Imperial great-grandfather Dao Kao temple disaster.
Jianshi first year, spring, first month, Yichou: the temple of the imperial great-grandfather Daokao suffered a disaster.
Literal English likewise splits 悼考; the disaster predicate applies to 悼考廟, the temple of Daokao.
Enfeoffed maternal uncle's various officials Guanglu Grandee and Guannei Marquis Wang Chong as Marquis of Ancheng.
His maternal uncle Wang Chong, Various Clerk and Grandee of Splendid Light, already ranked as a Marquis Within the Passes, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ancheng.
諸吏 is Wang Chong's singular added office, rendered elsewhere in this edition as Various Clerk; the original wrongly treats it as a plural group.
Enfeoffed maternal uncle various officials Guanglu Grandee Guannei Marquis Wang Chong as Ancheng Marquis.
His maternal uncle Wang Chong, Various Clerk, Grandee of Splendid Light, and Marquis Within the Passes, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ancheng.
Literal English must treat 諸吏 as Wang Chong's singular office, not transliterate it without explanation or invent a group of officials.
Dongping King Yu had a crime and was pared of Fan and Kangfu counties.
Dongping King Yu committed an offense and was deprived of Fan and Kangfu counties.
削樊、亢父縣 means the two counties were cut from King Yu's domain; 'was pared of' is ungrammatical and obscure.
Dongping King Yu had crime, pared Fan, Kangfu counties.
Dongping King Yu had committed an offense; Fan and Kangfu counties were removed from his domain.
The telegraph literal 'pared Fan, Kangfu counties' fails to show that 削 removes the counties from the king's holdings.

In the seventh month, a small girl named Chen from Sishang who held a bow heard the great flood was coming; she ran into the Horizontal City Gate, forced her way into the Shangfang lateral gate, and reached the Hooked Shield office in Weiyang Palace.

In the seventh month, Chen Chigong, a young girl from Sishang, heard that a great flood was coming. She ran through Hengcheng Gate, forced her way through the side gate of the Imperial Workshops, and reached the Gou Shield office in Weiyang Palace.
陳持弓 is the girl's personal name, as the parallel account in Hanshu 27 confirms; 橫城門 is the proper name Hengcheng Gate, while 尚方 and 鉤盾 are palace offices.

Seventh month, Sishang small girl Chen held a bow; hearing the great flood was coming, she ran into the Horizontal City Gate, forced her way into the Shangfang lateral gate, and reached the Hooked Shield office in Weiyang Palace.

Seventh month: Chen Chigong, a young girl from Sishang, heard that a great flood was coming. She ran through Hengcheng Gate, forced her way through the side gate of the Imperial Workshops, and reached the Gou Shield office in Weiyang Palace.
陳持弓 is Chen Chigong, not 'Chen held a bow'; the parallel account in Hanshu 27 supports the name and the proper palace locations.
In the fifth month, central usher chief Chen Lin killed Commander of the Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in the middle of the hall.
In the fifth month, Central Usher Chief Chen Lin killed Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in the middle of the hall.
司隸校尉 is a single office; stacking 'Commander' and 'Commandant' doubles one title.
Fifth month, central usher chief Chen Lin killed Commander of Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in hall middle.
Fifth month: Central Usher Chief Chen Lin killed Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in the middle of the hall.
Literal English likewise invents a double head for the one office 司隸校尉.
Jingning first year fifth month, Emperor Yuan collapsed.
In the fifth month of the first year of Jingning, Emperor Yuan died.
崩 is the conventional imperial death verb; 'collapsed' wrongly suggests physical collapse.
In the fifth month of summer, officials of 800 piculs and 500 piculs ranks were removed.
In the fifth month of summer, the 800- and 500-picul salary grades for officials were abolished.
除…八百石、五百石秩 abolishes those salary grades; it does not remove the officials who held them.
Summer fifth month, removed officials 800 piculs, 500 piculs ranks.
Summer, fifth month: abolished the 800-picul and 500-picul salary grades for officials.
Literal English must keep 秩 as the object of 除: the 800- and 500-picul grades are abolished.
On Renxu of the third month of spring in the third year, eight fallen stones in Dongjun.
On Renxu of the third month of spring in the third year, eight stones fell in Dong Commandery.
隕石東郡，八 is a complete report that eight stones fell in Dong Commandery; the original lacks a finite verb.
Third year spring third month Renxu, fallen stone Dongjun, eight.
Third year, spring, third month, Renxu: eight stones fell in Dong Commandery.
Literal English likewise needs a finite verb for 隕石…八: eight stones fell in Dong Commandery.

In the sixth month of summer, Yingchuan iron official convicts Shentu Sheng and 180 others killed the chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, called themselves generals, and experienced nine commanderies.

In the sixth month of summer, 180 convicts from the Yingchuan iron office, including Shentu Sheng, killed the chief officials, stole weapons from the arsenal, called themselves generals, and passed through nine commanderies.
申屠聖等百八十人 totals 180 including Shentu Sheng, and 經歷九郡 means they passed through nine commanderies.
Summer sixth month, Yingchuan iron official convicts Shentu Sheng etc. 180 people killed chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, self called generals, experienced nine commanderies.

Summer, sixth month: 180 convicts from the Yingchuan iron office, including Shentu Sheng, killed chief officials, stole arsenal weapons, called themselves generals, and passed through nine commanderies.
Literal English must not read 等百八十人 as Sheng plus 180 others, and 經歷 is transit through the commanderies.
Sent the Chancellor's chief clerk and Imperial Secretary's central overseer to pursue and capture them, undertaking affairs with military mobilization, and all submitted to their guilt.
The Chancellor's chief clerk and the Imperial Secretary's central overseer were sent to pursue and capture them under wartime regulations, and all were punished for their crimes.
以軍興從事 means acting under military-mobilization rules, and 皆伏辜 means all were punished for their crimes.
Sent Chancellor chief clerk, Imperial Secretary central overseer pursue capture, with military rise undertake affairs, all submitted guilt.
Sent the Chancellor's chief clerk and the Imperial Secretary's central overseer to pursue and capture them under military-mobilization rules; all were punished for their crimes.
Literal 'military rise…submitted guilt' mistranslates 軍興從事 and 伏辜; the proposed sense matches the Chinese.
Just at the spring growing time, I am about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li and others to recommend wronged prisons in Sanfu, Sanhe, and Hongnong.
Just at the season of spring growth, I am about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li and others to review cases of wrongful imprisonment in Sanfu, Sanhe, and Hongnong.
舉…冤獄 means to raise and review wrongful-imprisonment cases, not to recommend 'wronged prisons.'
Just spring growing time, about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li etc. recommend Sanfu, Sanhe, Hongnong wronged prisons.
Just at the season of spring growth, about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li and others to review wrongful-imprisonment cases in Sanfu, Sanhe, and Hongnong.
Literal English likewise misreads 冤獄 as prisons to recommend rather than wrongful cases to review.
On dingchou day of the eighth month, Grand Empress Dowager Wang collapsed.
On dingchou day of the eighth month, Grand Empress Dowager Wang died.
太皇太后王氏崩 records her death; 崩 is not physical collapse.
Eighth month dingchou day, Grand Empress Dowager Wang clan collapsed.
Eighth month, dingchou: Grand Empress Dowager Wang died.
Literal English must render imperial 崩 as died, not collapsed.
On Gengchen of the tenth month of winter, the Empress Dowager ordered officials to restore the Ganquan Supreme Altar, Fenying Houtu, Yong Five Altars, and Chencang Chenbao sacrifices.

On gengchen in the tenth month of winter, the Empress Dowager ordered officials to restore sacrifices at the Supreme Altar at Ganquan, the Earth Goddess shrine at Fenyin, the Five Altars at Yong, and Chenbao at Chencang.
汾陰 is Fenyin, not Fenying; the revision also makes clear that the sentence lists four restored sacrificial sites.
Winter tenth month Gengchen, Empress Dowager edict officials restore Ganquan Supreme Altar, Fenying Houtu, Yong Five Altars, Chencang Chenbao sacrifices.

Winter, tenth month, gengchen: the Empress Dowager ordered officials to restore sacrifices at the Supreme Altar at Ganquan, the Earth Goddess shrine at Fenyin, the Five Altars at Yong, and Chenbao at Chencang.
Literal English must spell 汾陰 as Fenyin and identify the listed names as sacrificial sites.
Runan Governor Yan Hong captured and beheaded Ling and the others.
Runan Governor Yan Xin captured and beheaded Ling and the others.
嚴訢 is Yan Xin; reading 訢 as Hong confuses him with the different name 閎.
Runan Governor Yan Hong captured beheaded Ling etc.
Yan Xin, Administrator of Runan, captured and beheaded Ling and the others.
Literal English must keep the given name Xin for 訢.
Hong was moved to Grand Minister of Agriculture and granted 100 catties of gold.
Yan Xin was appointed Grand Minister of Agriculture and granted one hundred catties of gold.
遷訢 continues Yan Xin from the previous sentence; Hong is the wrong referent, and the full name prevents an unclear bare given name.
Moved Hong to Grand Minister of Agriculture, granted gold 100 catties.
Yan Xin was appointed Grand Minister of Agriculture and granted one hundred catties of gold.
Literal English must take 訢 as Yan Xin, the same man as in s0220, and supply a grammatical subject.
The Commander of the Capital Region Commandant shall inspect those who do not change.'
The Capital Region Commandant shall inspect those who do not change.'
司隸校尉 is one office; 'Commander … Commandant' doubles the title again.
Those in position are silent and silent, rarely having loyal words.
Those in position are silent, rarely having loyal words.
默然 is a single adverb 'silently'; 'silent and silent' is a character-by-character misfire.
Enfeoffed Xiao Chancellor's descendant Xi as Marquis of Tan.
Xi, a descendant of Chancellor Xiao He, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Zan.
酇 is Zan, Xiao He's fief; the revision restores the correct place-name and makes the annal entry grammatical.
Enfeoffed Xiao Chancellor descendant Xi as Tan Marquis.
Xi, a descendant of Chancellor Xiao He, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Zan.
Literal English likewise must render 酇侯 as Marquis of Zan, not Marquis of Tan, and identify Xi as the subject.
In the third month, advanced noble rank to duke, and Zhou Chenghou Marquis all to dukes, with lands each 100 li.
In the third month, Kong Ji was raised to the rank of duke. The Marquis of Chengxiu, descendant of Zhou, was likewise made a duke; each received a domain one hundred li square.
承休 is Chengxiu, not Chenghou; the preceding units identify Kong Ji as the first subject, and both men received ducal rank and equal domains.
Third month, advanced noble rank to duke, and Zhou Chenghou Marquis all to dukes, lands each 100 li.
Third month: Kong Ji was raised to the rank of duke, and the Marquis of Chengxiu, descendant of Zhou, was likewise made a duke; each received a domain one hundred li square.
Literal English must read 承休 as Chengxiu and recover Kong Ji as the first subject from the immediately preceding sentence.
The Documents says: 'Only first advance the king to correct his affairs.'
The Documents says: 'It is the former kings who rectified their affairs.'
惟先假王正厥事 is the Shangshu line on former/sage kings correcting their affairs; 'Only first advance the king' mistranslates 假/格.
Granted maternal uncle Wang Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi the noble rank of Guannei Marquis.
Granted his maternal uncles Wang Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi the noble rank of Marquis Within the Passes.
賜舅王譚、商、立、根、逢時 names five maternal uncles; singular 'uncle' is wrong, and 關內侯 matches 'Marquis Within the Passes'.
In the sixth month of summer, maternal uncle Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi were all enfeoffed as marquises.
In the sixth month of summer, maternal uncles Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi were all enfeoffed as marquises.
封舅譚、商、立、根、逢時皆為列侯 lists five men under 舅; singular 'maternal uncle' misreads the plural series.
An edict declared: 'I have obtained to protect the ancestral temples, fearful and trembling, not able to live up to the title.
An edict declared: 'I have been entrusted with protecting the ancestral temples, fearful and trembling, not able to live up to the title.
朕獲保宗廟 means holding the charge of protecting the ancestral temples; 'I have obtained to protect' is ungrammatical and obscures that sense.
In the second month, the Chanyu was dismissed and returned to his country.
In the second month, the Chanyu concluded his visit and returned to his country.
After 單于來朝, 罷歸國 means the visit ended and he returned home, not that the Chanyu was dismissed from office.
Edict said: 'Formerly at Emperor Yao established Xi, He officials, commanded with four seasons affairs, caused not lose their order.
Edict said: 'Formerly Emperor Yao established the Xi and He officials, commanded them with the affairs of the four seasons, and caused them not to lose their order.
昔在帝堯立羲、和之官 is grammatical Chinese; 'Formerly at Emperor Yao established' is broken English and drops the clear objects of 命/令.
The Former Emperor promoted agriculture, thinned their rents and taxes, favored their strong strength, and caused them to be in the same category as filial younger brothers.

The Former Emperor promoted agriculture, lightened their rents and taxes, favored the able-bodied and industrious, and placed them in the same category as those practiced in filial piety and fraternal duty.
令與孝弟同科 uses 孝弟 as the ethical pair filial piety and fraternal duty, not 'filial younger brothers'; 寵其彊力 favors the able and industrious.
Former Emperor promoted agriculture, thinned their rents taxes, favored their strong strength, caused with filial younger brothers same category.
Former Emperor promoted agriculture, thinned their rents and taxes, favored their strong labor, caused them to be in the same category with filial piety and fraternal duty.
The same 孝弟 ethical pair is mistranslated in the literal as 'filial younger brothers'; the repair restores that sense and readable conjunctions.
In autumn, there was great flooding east of the pass, and floating people who wished to enter the Hangu, Tianjing, Hukou, and Wuran passes should not be harshly detained.
In autumn, there was great flooding east of the pass, and floating people who wished to enter the Hangu, Tianjing, Hukou, and Wuyan passes should not be harshly detained.
五阮關 is the pass name read Wuyan (阮 as yuán in this toponym); 'Wuran' is an erroneous romanization.
In ten days it was pacified, Hu was moved to Commander of the Guards, and granted 100 catties of gold.
Within about a month it was pacified; Hu was moved to Commander of the Guards and granted 100 catties of gold.
旬月平 means pacified within about a month across ten-day periods, not in literally ten days.
Ten days months pacified, moved Hu to Commander of the Guards, granted gold 100 catties.
Ten-day periods / a month pacified; moved Hu to Commander of the Guards; granted gold 100 catties.
Literal 'Ten days months' garbles 旬月; rendering it as ten-day periods or a month correctly reflects the compound.

Wannian was flattering and evil, not loyal, poison flowed to the multitude of common people, within the seas they resented and hoped, until now has not ceased. Though he received the pardon order, it is not proper for him to dwell in the capital.

Wannian was flattering and evil, not loyal; poison flowed to the multitude of common people; within the seas they harbored resentment, which has not ceased to this day. Though he received the pardon order, it is not proper for him to dwell in the capital.
海內怨望 means the empire harbored resentful grievance; 'resented and hoped' invents a false second sense for 望.

In the twelfth month, Shanyang iron official convicts Su Ling and 227 others attacked and killed chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, called themselves generals, experienced nineteen commanderies and kingdoms, and killed the Dongjun Governor and Runan Commandant.

In the twelfth month, Shanyang iron official convicts Su Ling and 227 others attacked and killed chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, called themselves generals, passed through nineteen commanderies and kingdoms, and killed the Dongjun Governor and Runan Commandant.
經歷郡國十九 means they passed through nineteen commanderies and kingdoms; 'experienced' is a misleading calque.
Send out the various ones from Duling who have not yet been favored to return home.
Sent out the various ones from Duling who had not yet been favored to return home.
出杜陵諸未嘗御者歸家 is narrative annals prose and should be past tense; present 'Send out' mismatches the chronicle voice.

Officials and people admire and emulate, mutually thus becoming custom, and desiring the common people to be frugal and moderate, with families providing and persons sufficient—how is this not difficult!

Officials and people admire and emulate, gradually thus becoming custom, and desiring the common people to be frugal and moderate, with families providing and persons sufficient—how is this not difficult!
浸以成俗 means the emulation gradually becomes custom; 'mutually' does not render 浸.
Lodged at Ceiyang palace and granted the attendant officials.
Lodged at Beiyang palace and granted the attendant officials.
Ceiyang is a corrupt reading of 萯陽; Yan Shigu cites 萯音倍, so Beiyang is the commentary-backed romanization rather than Fuyang.
Lodged Ceiyang palace, granted attendant officials.
Lodged Beiyang palace, granted attendant officials.
The literal likewise needs 萯陽 as Beiyang (萯音倍), not the corrupted Ceiyang or the weaker Fuyang alternative.
Formerly Cheng Tang received the mandate, was ranked as the three generations, and the sacrifices were abolished and extinguished.
Formerly Cheng Tang received the mandate, was ranked among the Three Dynasties, and the sacrifices were abolished and extinguished.
列為三代 means Cheng Tang was ranked among the Three Dynasties, not 'ranked as the three generations'.

Praise says: The minister's paternal aunt filled the rear palace as a Lady, and father, sons, and brothers served the curtains and canopy.
